chosen.text: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.

candidates.text: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.
candidates.context: Luke, writing in Acts to Theophilus and the church; describes the Berean Jews responding to Paul's preaching.
candidates.whyItFits: Commends eager reception of teaching paired with checking it against Scripture itself, which matches the call for AI answers to point back to the text.

candidates.text: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.
candidates.context: Paul to the church in Thessalonica, in closing instructions about community life and prophecy.
candidates.whyItFits: Encourages discernment toward any new voice, including AI; less tied to Scripture study specifically.

candidates.text: For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.
candidates.context: Solomon's father-to-son wisdom instruction in Proverbs.
candidates.whyItFits: Locates the source of wisdom in God, not in any tool; fits the question of where answers come from, but is more general.
